Read a Map (Vector or Raster) for Correction

Source: R/read_map.R
read_map.Rd

Reads a vector map (e.g., shapefile, GeoPackage) or a raster map (e.g., GeoTIFF) that is intended to be corrected.

Usage

read_map(map_path, shp_path = NULL, ...)

Arguments

map_path

A character string specifying the path to the input map file (e.g., a shapefile or GeoTIFF).

shp_path

An alias for map_path kept for backward compatibility.

...

Arguments passed to sf::st_read (for vector maps) or terra::rast (for raster maps).

Value

An sf object (for vector maps) or a terra::SpatRaster object (for raster maps).

Details

This function automatically detects whether the input file is a vector dataset or a raster dataset:

  • Vector maps (e.g., .shp, .gpkg, .geojson): Read using sf::st_read(). If the file contains polygon geometries and lacks an area_old column, initial feature areas are calculated and added.

  • Raster maps (e.g., .tif, .tiff, .geotiff, .asc, .grd): Read using terra::rast(), returning a terra::SpatRaster object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# First, create demo files (creates both vector and raster maps)
demo_files <- create_demo_data()

# Read the vector map that needs correction
vector_map <- read_map(demo_files$shp_path, quiet = TRUE)

# Read the raster map that needs correction
raster_map <- read_map(demo_files$raster_path)
print(raster_map)
} # }
